response.justification: While the candidate demonstrates strong engineering practices and has relevant domain exposure from RIDE Capital's investment platform work, they critically lack the mandatory technical requirements. C++ experience is minimal (~6 months in 2014-2015, 11 years ago) versus the required 5-10 years of hands-on expertise. No Windows platform or SQL Server/Oracle expertise is evident. The candidate's 15-year career trajectory emphasizes web development, TypeScript, and JavaScript, demonstrating divergence from C++ specialization. Substantial technical ramp-up would be required for core job requirements.
strengths: Capital markets domain exposure from RIDE Capital investment platform role
Exemplary software engineering practices including TDD, CI/CD, and trunk-based development
Strong communication and knowledge-sharing abilities demonstrated through talks and workshops
concerns: Critically insufficient C++ experience (single 6-month role in 2014-2015; requirement is 5-10 years)
No evidence of Windows platform specialization or SQL Server/Oracle database expertise
Career trajectory has diverged from C++ toward web development stack over the past 15 years
